chlorpyrifos||mancozeb.reason: Chlorpyrifos (IRAC 1B) and Mancozeb (FRAC M03) target different pests/diseases; combined insecticide+fungicide spray in a single pass is standard Indian field practice to reduce spray rounds and labour cost.
chlorpyrifos||mancozeb.notes: Standard jar test recommended, especially first time combining these two brands. Cartap hydrochloride + Validamycin is a widely used standard rice combination (stem borer + sheath blight) in Indian paddy programs.

chlorpyrifos||mancozeb.cropNotes: Spot-test on a small area before full-field spray; avoid application during flowering/fruit-set in sensitive crops; follow the longer of the two products' pre-harvest intervals (PHI).

formulations.reason: Conditional - Mixing a flowable-type formulation with an oil-based EC/OD is common field practice but needs correct mixing order.
formulations.risk: If the EC/OD is added to the tank before the dry/flowable/soluble product is fully dispersed, an oily 'pancake-batter'-like layer can form that will not mix back in.
formulations.mixOrder: Add the non-oil-based product first and fully disperse it, then add the EC/OD last (before only surfactants).
formulations.jarAdvice: Recommended, particularly for a new brand/active combination.
